# Skipi

> Skipi is a maritime ecosystem with an AI assistant and public entry points for seafarers, crewing managers and brokers. This file lists canonical discovery routes; it does not imply access or availability beyond what each destination currently shows.

## Canonical product pages

- Product site: https://skipi.app/
- Product overview: https://skipi.app/story/
- Resources for agents: https://skipi.app/for-agents/
- Downloads: https://skipi.app/downloads
- Support: https://skipi.app/support/

## Product entry points

- Seafarer: https://assistant.skipi.app
- Crewing manager: https://assistant.skipi.app/app/crewing
- Broker: https://assistant.skipi.app/app/broker

Verify current access and availability at the destination. A listed route is not a promise that every visitor can use every function.

## Machine-readable files

- Structured site summary: https://skipi.app/site-summary.json
- Sitemap: https://skipi.app/sitemap.xml
- Crawler rules: https://skipi.app/robots.txt

## Related public data

Skipi Vacancy Index is a separate discovery and analysis surface for maritime salary benchmarks and public maritime signals. Its own methodology and caveats govern its data.

- Site: https://skipi.info/
- Agent guide: https://skipi.info/llms.txt
- Methodology: https://skipi.info/methodology.html
- Structured salary index: https://skipi.info/data/index_latest.json
- Public maritime signals: https://skipi.info/data/signals/latest.json
- Seafarer feed: https://skipi.info/data/seafarer/latest.json

Do not infer unlisted endpoints, access rights or product capabilities from these discovery files.
